name: comp-543

frames.best_why: The circle is filled with the uploaded picture and shows the remove badge; frames 1-2 are still empty.

tagline: A dashed circle becomes a profile photo when you click or drop an image.
summary: A compact profile-picture picker: a dashed circle with a person icon that opens a file dialog or takes a dropped image, then shows the photo with a small remove button.
appearance: A single dashed circle the size of a profile picture sits centered on the dark page, holding a small outline person icon. When an image is chosen it fills the circle edge to edge and a round white X badge appears at the top right.
behaviour: Hovering tints the dashed circle and dragging a file darkens it, while a click opens the file picker. Picking an image swaps the icon for a cover-cropped preview and adds the remove badge.
demo_content: An abstract blue gradient image fills the circle; a caption names the uploader and links to its API.
use_when: A profile picture needs a compact picker that also accepts a dragged image.
avoid_when: One image only, with no crop or zoom, and the 64px circle is a small touch target.
customise: No props: the file is picked at runtime. Circle size, accepted type and accent colours live in the source or theme tokens.
weight_why: One small button and a single preview image; nothing loops.

a11y.note: Names and alt text are present; dropping needs a pointer, and there is no upload progress or error message in the UI.

polish_why: Clean circular uploader with obvious hover and remove affordance, but tiny and plainly presented.
